title: ScaLoginCompleteRequest
description: Completes an SCA login by submitting the proof for the started factor. Carries the same proof fields as an `ScaAuthorization` (`code` for `SMS_OTP` / `TOTP`, or `passkeyAssertion` + `origin` for `PASSKEY`), plus the `factor` being completed and, for `SMS_OTP`, the `challengeId` returned by the login start.

factor.description: The factor being completed; must match the started login.

challengeId.description: The challenge handle returned by the login start, required for `SMS_OTP` and omitted for other factors.

code.description: The one-time code the customer received by SMS, or read from their authenticator app. Provide for `SMS_OTP` / `TOTP`. In sandbox, the code is always `123456`.

passkeyAssertion.description: Opaque WebAuthn assertion produced by the device from the login start's `passkeyOptions`. Required when completing a `PASSKEY` login.

origin.description: The WebAuthn origin the `passkeyAssertion` was produced against (one of the login start's `allowedOrigins`). Required alongside `passkeyAssertion`; omit it for the `code` path.

ScaFactor.description:
A Strong Customer Authentication factor.

| Factor | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `SMS_OTP` | One-time code sent by SMS to the customer's verified phone. Requires no prior enrollment. |
| `TOTP` | Time-based one-time code from an authenticator app. Requires enrollment. Not valid for per-transaction challenges (cannot carry dynamic linking). |
| `PASSKEY` | WebAuthn passkey assertion. Requires enrollment. |
